description: Refactor the app into a deployable AI-driven study execution system with daily planning, listening/speaking-oriented training, server-side LLM routing, cloud persistence, and persistent AI context.

userStories.title: Add daily plan data model normalization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need normalized daily plan state so that the app can persist and reload today's study plan safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add normalized daily plan state with date, available_minutes, plan_type, focus_lessons, tasks, completion_criteria, and ai_summary
Existing users without daily plan data load without errors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add lesson mastery normalization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need lesson mastery records so that the app can track grammar, listening, speaking, and reading strength by lesson.
acceptanceCriteria: Add lesson_mastery records with grammar, listening, speaking, reading, and last_reviewed_at fields
Existing progress.current_lesson remains supported
Existing users without lesson_mastery load without errors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add pattern mastery normalization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need pattern mastery records so that the app can target weak sentence patterns during planning and training.
acceptanceCriteria: Add pattern_mastery records with lesson, pattern id, recognition, controlled_output, free_output, and last_practiced_at

Typecheck passes
Tests pass

acceptanceCriteria: Add a rule module that generates plan type, time allocation, required tasks, and optional tasks

Rules support foundation review, new lesson, listening_speaking, mistake_review, and weekend_long_session plan types
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add daily plan store actions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need store actions for plan creation and task status updates so that plan execution can be tracked consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add store actions to create a daily plan from rule output
Add task status updates for pending, in_progress, completed, and skipped

Tests pass

userStories.title: Create persistence adapter abstraction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a persistence adapter layer so that local and cloud-backed storage can share one contract.
